title: Ordering at a café
context: You are at a café counter.

n1.speaker: Barista
n1.say: Hi! What can I get you?

choices.feedbackSo: Waa codsi edeb leh oo si dabiici ah loo yiri.
Waa la fahmi karaa, laakiin ku darista “fadlan” waxay hadalka ka dhigaysaa mid saaxiibtinimo badan.

choices.feedback: This sounds rude. Use 'I'd like...' or 'Could I have...'.
choices.feedbackSo: Hadalkaani wuxuu u muuqdaa amar qallafsan. Isticmaal “Waxaan jeclaan lahaa...” ama “Ma heli karaa...?”

n2.speaker: Barista
n2.say: Sure. Would you like anything else?

choices.feedback: Good. You added a request politely.
choices.textSo: Haa, keeg yar oo muffin ah, fadlan.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa hagaag. Codsi kale ayaad si edeb leh ugu dartay.

choices.feedback: Too abrupt. Try 'Sorry, could you repeat that?'
choices.feedbackSo: Jawaabtu aad bay u gaaban tahay. Isku day: “Raalli ahow, ma ku celin kartaa?”

end.speaker: Barista
end.say: Great, I'll have that ready for you in a moment.
end.saySo: Wanaagsan, wax yar kadib ayaan kuu diyaarinayaa.

contextSo: Waxaad joogtaa miiska dalabka ee maqaayad yar.

title: Job interview basics
context: You are at the start of a job interview for a customer service role.

n1.speaker: Interviewer
n1.say: Tell me a little about yourself.

choices.text: I have three years of experience in customer service, and I enjoy helping people.
choices.textSo: Waxaan leeyahay saddex sano oo waayo-aragnimo ah oo ku saabsan adeegga macaamiisha, waxaana jeclahay inaan dadka caawiyo.
choices.feedbackSo: Jawaab kooban, shaqada khusaysa, oo wanaagsan.

choices.text: I am a person who likes things.
choices.feedback: Too vague. Mention your experience and strengths.
choices.feedbackSo: Jawaabtu ma cadda. Sheeg waayo-aragnimadaada iyo awoodahaaga.

choices.text: I don't know what to say.
choices.feedback: Prepare a short answer about your work and skills in advance.
choices.feedbackSo: Hore u sii diyaari jawaab kooban oo ku saabsan shaqadaadii iyo xirfadahaaga.

n2.speaker: Interviewer
n2.say: Why do you want this job?

choices.text: I like the company's focus on training, and I want to grow my skills.
choices.feedback: It links your goals to the employer.
choices.textSo: Waxaan jeclahay sida shirkaddu u dhiirrigeliso tababarka, waxaanan rabaa inaan xirfadahayga horumariyo.
choices.feedbackSo: Waxay isku xidhaysaa yoolalkaaga iyo waxa shaqo-bixiyuhu bixiyo.

choices.feedback: Honest, but add a reason related to the role.
choices.textSo: Sababtoo ah saaxiibkay ayaa halkan ka shaqeeya.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa run, laakiin ku dar sabab la xidhiidha shaqada lafteeda.

choices.feedback: It may be true, but focus on what you can offer.
choices.feedbackSo: Taasi run bay noqon kartaa, laakiin xoogga saar waxa aad shaqada ku soo kordhin karto.

n3.speaker: Interviewer
n3.say: Do you have any questions for us?

choices.text: Yes, what does a typical day look like in this role?
choices.textSo: Haa, maalinta shaqo ee caadiga ah sidee ayay u ekaataa booskan?
choices.feedbackSo: Su’aal weydiintu waxay muujinaysaa inaad shaqada danaynayso.

choices.feedback: Acceptable, but a question shows you are engaged.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa la aqbali karaa, laakiin su’aal weydiintu waxay muujinaysaa inaad si dhab ah uga qayb qaadanayso wareysiga.

n3.saySo: Ma jiraan wax su’aalo ah oo aad doonayso inaad na weydiiso?

end.speaker: Interviewer
end.say: Thank you. We'll be in touch soon.
end.saySo: Mahadsanid. Dhawaan ayaan kula soo xidhiidhi doonnaa.

contextSo: Waxaad ku jirtaa bilowga wareysi shaqo oo loogu talagalay booska adeegga macaamiisha.
